title: Veno Valley Additions
description: Add mobs from the work in progress series Veno Valley.
body:
This mod adds character from Veno Valley ~~Rifland~~ to your Minecraft world.

These characters include:
<details>
<summary>Don't look if you want a suprise</summary>

 Bob, Dread, Rayz, Lisley, PB&EJ, Rico Rumble, Veno, Nathen, Neon, Rayten, Xenon, Deno, and more.

</details>



It also adds a new biome, new items, and a new structure.

The new items includes armor that can give you speed or strength, and a few new weapons.

This mod will provide a challenge at the beginning, but 

!THIS MOD IS CURRENTLY IN BETA!

This is still being worked on currently.

CREDITS FOR THE CHARACTERS:

Me (@DreadAnimates YT) for Dread

@bfsm_OFFICIAL for Veno, Lisley, Deno, PB&EJ, Xenon, and Rayten.

@Neon_BFSM for Neon and Nightmare Neon.

All other characters I don't own fully.

Please enjoy my mod and notify me about any bugs!
